cues.en: Hey there, friend.
cues.zh: 嗨，朋友。

cues.en: It's Bruno again.
cues.zh: 又是 Bruno。

cues.en: By the way, you've really impressed me over the last couple of days, but, hey, I have something to ask of you.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，這幾天你真的讓我印象深刻，不過有件事想請你幫忙。

cues.en: I know it's the weekend.
cues.zh: 我知道快到週末了。

cues.en: I know it's Friday, but we had a last minute issue with one of our clients, and we need your help as soon as possible.
cues.zh: 今天是星期五，但一位客戶臨時出狀況，需要你盡快協助。

cues.en: You see, this client hosts one of the world's biggest dog competitions, and unfortunately, all their data has been wiped from the dog profiles.
cues.zh: 客戶主辦全球最大的狗狗比賽之一，不幸的是，狗狗個人資料全被清掉了。

cues.en: All these dogs are going to be competing this weekend and they need an online profile.
cues.zh: 所有狗狗這個週末都要參賽，而且需要線上介紹頁。

cues.en: And up until now, they've had humans manually create the dog profiles.
cues.zh: 以前都是人工建立狗狗介紹。

cues.en: But unfortunately, the competition is this weekend and their data, when it comes to what the dogs breeds are is completely gone.
cues.zh: 但比賽就在這週末，記錄品種的資料，卻全部不見了。

cues.en: And they have thousands of dogs.
cues.zh: 而且有數千隻狗。

cues.en: And there's no way that a single person that they've hired can do this.
cues.zh: 聘請的一個人，根本不可能做完。

cues.en: So I need you to create a machine learning model that can detect the dog breed from a picture, and they need it ASAP in a couple of hours.
cues.zh: 所以需要你建立機器學習模型，從照片辨識狗的品種；必須盡快，幾個小時內完成。

cues.en: So you can do this, right?
cues.zh: 你做得到，對吧？

cues.en: I told them that it's no problem that we have a star, a machine learning expert here, so don't disappoint.
cues.zh: 我已跟客戶說沒問題，我們這裡有一位明星機器學習專家，別讓大家失望。

cues.en: All right, everybody, this is going to be a fun one.
cues.zh: 好，各位，這會很有趣。

cues.en: We're going to learn about neural networks.
cues.zh: 我們會學習神經網路。

cues.en: Up until now, we had some really good structured data in CSV forms.
cues.zh: 之前都是 CSV 格式、整理得很好的結構化資料。

cues.en: But now we get to images.
cues.zh: 但現在要處理影像。

cues.en: No more Excel files with rows and columns that were easy to understand.
cues.zh: 不再是容易理解、有列有欄的 Excel 檔。

cues.en: How can we teach a computer to know what a dog is, what a dog breed is?
cues.zh: 如何教電腦知道什麼是狗，以及狗的品種？

cues.en: This section is going to be a lot of fun.
cues.zh: 這一節會很有意思。

cues.en: We're going to use tools like TensorFlow Transfer Learning and deep learning to dive into this topic,
cues.zh: 會使用 TensorFlow、遷移學習與深度學習，深入探索這個，

cues.en: a topic that is becoming more and more important in the industry.
cues.zh: 在業界越來越重要的主題。

cues.en: And at the end of the day, we're going to build a machine learning model that is able to detect dog breeds.
cues.zh: 最後建立能辨識狗狗品種的機器學習模型。

cues.en: It's going to be a lot of fun and it's going to be a fun project to add to your portfolio.
cues.zh: 會很有趣，也很適合加入作品集。

cues.en: So let's get started.
cues.zh: 開始吧。
